select u.*, d.name as "deptName", ( select string_agg(role_data.name, ', ' order by role_data.sort) from ( select distinct r.name, r.sort from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.id ) role_data ) as "roleName", ( select string_agg(post_data.post_name, ', ' order by post_data.post_sort) from ( select distinct p.post_name, p.post_sort from sys_user_org_post uop join sys_post p on p.id = uop.post_id where uop.user_id = u.id and uop.status = 1 ) post_data ) as "postName" from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id
and u.username like concat('%', #{queryParams.username}, '%')
and u.nickname like concat('%', #{queryParams.nickname}, '%')
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_org_post x where x.user_id = u.id and x.status = 1 and x.dept_id = #{queryParams.deptId} )
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role x where x.user_id = u.id and x.role_id = #{queryParams.roleId} )
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_org_post x where x.user_id = u.id and x.status = 1 and x.post_id = #{queryParams.postId} )
and u.status = #{queryParams.status}

select u.*, d.name as "deptName", ( select string_agg(role_data.name, ', ' order by role_data.sort) from ( select distinct r.name, r.sort from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.id ) role_data ) as "roleName", ( select string_agg(post_data.post_name, ', ' order by post_data.post_sort) from ( select distinct p.post_name, p.post_sort from sys_user_org_post uop join sys_post p on p.id = uop.post_id where uop.user_id = u.id and uop.status = 1 ) post_data ) as "postName" from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where u.id = #{id}
